title: 10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty
summary: A response to Revival Fitness's 10 signs of a fake natty video, setting noble natties (GVS, NH) against blackpilled natties. He argues the everyone-is-on-PEDs cynicism is a non sequitur that pushes young men toward drugs, makes the case that PEDs are hard drugs, and argues that strength and hypertrophy training really differ.
claims: The natural community is split between noble natties (GVS, NH) built on pride and self-respect and blackpilled natties (Revival Fitness) built on resentment and cynicism
Tens of thousands of young men sacrifice their health on PEDs and still do not make it, which shows PEDs are not a good idea for anyone
Most people judge natty status by whether they like the person, not by logic
Mass monsters at 250-300 lb lean are on huge doses and lie about it (e.g. Dorian Yates claiming low doses) to protect their legacy
Going from mass monsters use lots of drugs to anyone might be enhanced is a non sequitur: not being able to prove someone natty does not mean everyone is on
Telling young men that everyone with a good physique is on drugs directly encourages them to take PEDs to look the same
The rule that claiming natty means you are not natty is an unfalsifiable catch-22, which reveals dishonest intent
Creating pride in being natty and preaching it is the most effective way to keep the most young men natural
PEDs are hard drugs, physically addictive: coming off loses the gains and causes depression and mood swings that push users back on
PEDs are psychologically addictive: users cannot finish PCT, switch to blast and cruise, keep using despite terrible bloodwork, obsess over the topic and escalate to grams
PEDs cause organ failure, heart complications, poor blood panels, high blood pressure and cancers, and planned small doses do not stay small
Self-injecting with a syringe outside a medical setting is itself a sign you are doing something abnormal and harmful
Refusing to stigmatize PEDs is not enlightenment but cowardice and lack of a moral compass; many blackpilled natties secretly want to juice
Jokes about tren and test normalize PEDs; the PED boom comes from absence of prevention, not from moral policing
PED promotion vastly outweighs anti-PED prevention on YouTube; most natties stay silent
Every week he gets messages from young men who were on or about to start juice and stopped after his videos
He would never collab with a PED user, though he understands naturals doing so to gain clout
Anime physiques being unattainable is irrelevant; natties dislike PED users for lying and being bad role models, not for being bigger
Honest PED users can be good role models: John Meadows gave great advice, and Rich Piana's openness about self-destruction is one reason he stayed natural
Time frame is one of the best indicators of drug use: genetics speed progress but nobody gets 10 years of results in 2 naturally, e.g. a huge change from 16 to 18
What counts as eye-popping is subjective and depends on your own experience: he has 18-inch arms so they look normal to him, and 19-inch arms after 15 years is just a good job
An intermediate judges natty status from an intermediate's height; someone looking bigger may simply have trained longer or better
Gaining while cutting is usually an illusion from pump, tan and posing; on the scale those people are losing
He weighs 220 lb but does not look it sitting without a pump; if he lost 20-30 lb and posed pumped, people would say he got bigger
Pump, lighting, angle, height and bodyfat hugely change how a physique looks in photos
A natty friend at his gym will compete at 145 lb, looks like a Greek god on stage by being shredded, and should win his class
By bodybuilding stage standards he is fat
An Alex Eubank-type physique (170 lb, six-pack, somewhat capped delts) is common among 20-year-olds in his gym; if you think it is not natural, your standards are at the bottom of the barrel
Lean physiques at 6'1 and 180-190 lb are reachable naturally
Natty-or-not content produces nothing good: it feeds insecurity and blames others instead of taking responsibility
The Gymshark influencers (David Laid, the McKennas) were the fake natties of his generation
The algorithm is a mirror: if all you see is fake-natty influencers, it is because you click on them; many small natty channels give excellent advice
Powerlifters are not small but are small for their strength, and their physiques are imbalanced: big legs, chest, front delts and traps with underdeveloped arms and parts of the back
At the same bodyweight bodybuilders are weaker and powerlifters stronger; since genetics do not explain this, training parameters do, so strength and hypertrophy training differ
IFBB pros at 250-270 lb deadlifting about 600 lb is weak for their size, since 160 lb powerlifters pull that; their size comes mostly from drugs
Natural powerlifters never match natural bodybuilders for size and balance, and natural bodybuilders never outlift powerlifters: specializing in one quality costs the other
Ronnie trained heavy on the big three but most of his bodybuilding program was not built on them; the big three were maybe 5% of Arnold's volume
Strength copers are intermediates who want aesthetics but believe get strong to get big; he was one, obsessed with maxing out the big three, and it led him nowhere
The big three are about a tenth of the body's strength potential; big natties like GVS may be weak on squat, bench and deadlift but strong on isolations and back work
Accept that you might be average: average is fine, muscles still grow, just more slowly
You cannot build a healthy community if your main driver is resentment
